question: What should one make in solitude while intent on meditation?
premises: ekānte bahudhā rūpaṃ kuru dhyānañ ca tatparaḥ
in solitude one should make form in many ways
one should be intent on meditation
inference: In solitude, one should make form in many ways and be intent on meditation.
uncertainties: whether dhyānañ is object of kuru or separate
plain_english: In solitude, make form in many ways and be intent on meditation.
